summary: Atlas Energy Solutions filed an 8-K reporting that indirect subsidiary Shackelford 1, LLC signed two purchase agreements with Wyoming Machinery Company d/b/a Energy Solutions on September 18, 2026, covering balance-of-plant equipment for about $340.5 million and roughly 328 MW of power generation equipment for about $273.0 million, a combined commitment near $613.5 million. Payments run through May 2027 and January 2028, with 10% of the BoP price withheld and Caterpillar tariff pass-throughs. A leading frontier AI lab is the intended offtaker and cost-reimbursement counterparty. No securities, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or change-of-control terms are stated; ordinary equipment procurement, not a special situation. Key watch item is counterparty performance and termination-for-convenience cancellation costs.
